title: MCP server rollout plan
body: Ship the notes server to the desktop hosts first, then the web app.

title: Retro: March incident
body: The deploy pipeline stalled because the cache key ignored the lockfile.

title: Tool naming conventions
body: Keep MCP tool names snake_case and under 64 characters so every host accepts them.

title: Onboarding checklist
body: Laptop, SSO, the mcp hosts config, and a pairing session in week one.

title: Quarterly offsite logistics
body: Book the venue in Porto, collect dietary needs, plan the boat trip.

title: Mcp inspector tips
body: Run the inspector against src/server.ts to poke at tools by hand.

title: Rate limits for search
body: Search queries hit the index directly; MCP clients may retry aggressively.

title: Design review: notes v2
body: Structured output for list tools so MCP hosts can render tables.

title: Postgres upgrade notes
body: Upgrade the replicas first; the mcp audit table needs a new index.

title: Hiring loop
body: Two technical interviews and one product conversation; MCP experience is a plus.

title: Office move checklist
body: Movers on Friday. Mind the zebra crossing when unloading the van.

title: Prompt library
body: Prompts the MCP server could expose next: weekly summary and stand-up notes.

title: Security review: MCP tokens
body: Hosts pass no credentials over stdio; the server reads the notes file only.

title: On-call handbook
body: Page the owner of the failing check; the mCp server has no pager yet.
